title: reversible-cover / 12:12 cue versus the 534brn q-reversal
external_cover_cues: a 2022 community suggestion explicitly proposed digitally reversing the reversible cover
reason: A reversible cover admits front/back swap, horizontal mirror, vertical mirror, 180-degree rotation, and reading-direction changes. Nothing on the cover labels the machine's Q axis or selects the 2,1,0 ordering.
epistemic_effect: The cover modestly strengthens reversal/re-registration as a general Playdead operation family but does not close Experiment 389's exact q-reversal provenance gap.
